mobile: Explicitly deferred by the user; no mobile launch, device acceptance or status closure.
scope: Two complete themes on a Windows optimized native application and an installed production Tampermonkey script. Exact artifacts and input classes remain separate.

environment.scrollViewport: 950x600 desktop emulation; deviceScaleFactor 1. The keyboard/form cases use the original 1.75 scale.

windows.build: Optimized x86_64-pc-windows-msvc; --locked --no-default-features; tauri/custom-protocol; independent application identifier only. The normal production app and its data were left running/untouched.

installedGm.manager: Actual Tampermonkey, loaded from the existing 5.5.0 extension files in a dedicated profile. Production script installed from the bounded localhost artifact server, with no preview GM substitute.
installedGm.limit: The served artifact hash and install UI identify the input; the manager editor was not independently hashed. This installed bundle predates the final Studio settings width-container repair.

methods.matrix: Public named theme/navigation/appearance actions, live readonly feature props, deep Shadow DOM geometry and same-reference idle audio sampling. These are DOM/layout samples, not active media or 240 screenshot/input passes.
methods.nativeInput: Trusted CDP pointer and keyboard events at original display scale; Enter includes its character event and Shift uses modifier 8. No physical human keyboard/mouse or touch claim.
methods.scrolling: 36 actual playlists created through the product create action; trusted wheel on native WebView; public theme selection; no spacer or synthetic scrollTop assignment.
methods.recovery: Controlled existing modules.openRecovery entry followed by actual Tab and Retry controls; no naturally occurring startup failure claim.

matrix.hostIsolation: The installed GM host retained its one original hostile stylesheet; theme buttons were isolated in Shadow DOM.

repairs.problem: Theme replacement disposed AccountSettingsPanel, which closed the application-owned account dialog/session. Native account name/connection and proxy drafts were also presentation-owned.
repairs.change: Only the actual host settings-close/navigation resets native editor cells. Presentation disposal releases its focus-trap contribution. Proxy draft, validation and pending save receipt survive replacement without resubmitting.
repairs.verification: Native account draft round trip, forward/reverse Tab, native proxy draft round trip and close/reset; lifecycle, ordered connection/name editor and pending-save regression tests.

repairs.problem: Studio settings inherited the 1100px general page breakpoint; the dialog classified itself as narrow and stacked every category above its content.
repairs.change: Give settings a width container and its own 720px child split breakpoint. Wide desktop dialogs use two columns; a 760px window stacks without horizontal overflow.
repairs.verification: Final native 1280px two-column and 760px one-column geometry, reviewed before/after screenshots, plus the recorded page/appearance matrix.

checks.command: pnpm --filter @any-music/tauri exec vitest run test/components/accounts test/features/accounts

excludedAttempts: A parallel root run failed at an optional native resource-cache read. That code has a 100ms hot-path deadline, but the trace did not establish the cause. The exact test passed alone and full root tests passed with RUST_TEST_THREADS=1; no production deadline was relaxed.
The first GM full matrix awaited animation frames while the dedicated browser was hidden and timed out. Its partial work is excluded; the completed 120-cell matrix is retained.
GM wheel input acknowledgements timed out/background keyboard samples did not establish the long-scroll case. The later browser restart was automatically rejected; no GM long-scroll pass is inferred.
Early native input attempts at an emulated display scale, an incomplete Enter event and incorrect Shift modifier are excluded. Final input cases use the original display scale and corrected events.
Before a material collection exists, Classic intentionally omits title/filter controls; collection creation also resets its filter. Accepted specialist drafts are typed after that explicit setup.
An intermediate settings layout candidate lacked its own width container. Its narrow sample failed and is excluded; only the delivered artifact has the accepted responsive layout.

blockers.result: Automatic approval review rejected the restart command with blocked by policy; no more specific reason was provided.
blockers.effect: Could not finish the final installed-GM repeat after the Studio stylesheet repair. No bypass attempted.

blockers.action: Complete OS-native picker/install/consent and physical-input acceptance
blockers.result: The enabled computer-use inventory exposed no native application control surface. WebView interface observations do not establish OS dialog operations or physical human input.
blockers.effect: These exits remain open; no successful native save/installation is inferred.

gm: Install/revalidate the final production bundle, including the final Studio settings layout, and finish this build's input/scroll/cold-start follow-up.
Physical human keyboard/mouse/touch, other browser/manager combinations, and unrecorded source/account/entitlement combinations.
windows: Physical human input; full native system file/directory-picker and install/consent interactions; untested account/permission combinations. Interface rendering and native snapshot reads do not close those operations.
remaining.sourceAndMedia: This pass does not repeat authenticated source transport, active playback, downloads, native saves or every source/account combination. Prior R1-R4/native evidence retains its own recorded artifact scope.
remaining.mobile: Deferred unchanged; Android/iOS exits remain with their existing records.

screenshots.review: Representative before/after native settings, native recovery and installed GM screenshots reviewed separately from the 240 DOM matrix cases.
